page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Marginal notes in the right margin: "ab Almohadis." beside the canon "Almoravidas pepulerunt Almohadas." and "à Merinis" beside "Almohadas destruxerunt Merini." Signature "E 2" and catchword "mu-" at the foot. The left-edge fragments belong to the facing page and are not transcribed.

main_text.p: cam[?] usq; adÆgyptum & Nigritarum regionem, cum universi Hispanis, domuit & Monarcha transmarinus & cismarinus factus est. Hic con-didit urbem Marucco, quæ in poste-rum[?] imperii sedes fuit.
main_text.head: Periodus IV.
Canon.
Explicatio.
main_text.p: A. C. 1139 quidam Ludimagi-ster, cui nomen Elmahadi, spe reli-gionis reformandæ Africæ & Hispa-niæ, Pontificatu potitus est. Cujus Successores, inprimis Jacob Alman-sor, omnium latissimè imperarunt.
main_text.head: Periodus V.
Canon.
Explicatio I.
main_text.p: Circa A. C. 1210. Causa hujus mu-

page.notes: The first word "cam" is doubtful and may be "eam". "poste-rum" has a hyphen-like mark that may be a period. The Explicatio number reads "I." on the scan. The note "à" is printed with an accent that may be a grave. The original heads "Periodus" and "Canon." are given levels 2 and 3 because the scan shows no fixed level for them. Italic is shown for "Marucco", "Almohadas." and "Merini.". The margin notes are placed at the lines where they stand.
